verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Evidence-backed grading and verdict validation: completed scenarios flow into globally bounded graders, artifact-only blind grading, mandatory evidence validation, invalid-verdict retry, repeated-failure flagging, and valid-verdict assembly.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The run fingerprint is shown only generically and does not enumerate the tested revision, configuration, prompt versions, and rubric versions required to define comparison compatibility.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board substantially covers the harness from pinned inputs through bounded isolated execution, evidence-backed grading, scorecard assembly, compatible comparison, retention, and promotion. The strongest coverage is the grading/evidence-validation cluster. Material partials remain around fingerprint contents, ordered worker steps, record-before-continue behavior, independent/concurrent criterion grading, disputed-score re-examination, and the compatibility qualifier on future baselines; the wording-change rationale is absent. Weighted coverage is 49.5 of 57.
